operational_blockers.source: persisted provider diagnostic state; no credential modification or fresh authentication attempted

coverage_limits: Review was limited to the supplied source and tests; the full repository and full test suite were not independently executed.
PostgreSQL fault-injection and deployment fixture results were assessed from source rather than rerun during this review.
Deployment fixtures mock systemd, process environments, PostgreSQL administration, builds, and filesystem ownership; they do not constitute a disposable-host installation test.
Whole-host power-loss atomicity, shared infrastructure failure, and multi-host active/active operation are outside the stated guarantees.

health_window.scope: Bounded healthy observation >5 minutes. Collector ended intentionally after reset proof; unlimited client lifetime precludes the originally anticipated expiry-cycle wait.

native_output.remote_operations: login and fresh inbound inventory only; no config mutations
native_output.scope: Fresh native identity/enabled/expiry evidence at observed times. Rechecks output for concurrent removals; does not test mobile traffic, remaining-byte quotas, device limits or full routing data plane.

limits: No zero-failure guarantee. Host, PostgreSQL and network remain shared; multi-host active/active fencing is outside scope.
Sixteen complete-shell install/upgrade fixtures mocked OS commands; no complete disposable-host install was performed. Exact-binary systemd recovery was exercised separately.
External watchdog fixture used five seconds; production effective watchdog was verified as forty-five seconds. No production fault injection.
Successful SQL result with a lost acknowledgement was modeled around an actual committed result; no PostgreSQL wire-level COMMIT-response-loss test.
Corrupt restart ledgers deliberately refuse admission and preserve evidence; automatic destructive repair is not implemented.
Native readback proves configuration identity/enabled/expiry at observed times; no full mobile traffic, quota, device-limit or residential data-plane proof.
Both profiles already had lifetime zero/unlimited before deployment. No newly born client full expiry/delete cycle is claimed; isolated expiry/delete regressions passed.
Current provider states are persisted diagnostics; credentials and billing were not changed and the root cause of Vultr Unauthorized was not independently established.
